stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]以下哪三项包含在金融行动特别工作组(FATF)评估技术合规性以及反洗钱/打击恐怖融资/打击扩散融资系统有效性的相互评估方法中所概述的11项即时成果内？(选择三项.)

options.A: 国际合作为打击犯罪分子提供了可操作的信息
options.B: 被判犯有洗钱罪的人被拒绝获得基本银行服务.
options.C: 洗钱犯罪行为受到调查并被提起刑事诉讼
options.D: 金融情报信息由相关机构收集,并与金融行动特别工作组(FATF)共享,以作进一步调查.
options.E: 监管部门对金融机构和非银行金融机构及其基于风险的反洗钱/打击恐怖主义融资实施有效监管

stem_en: Which of the following are included in the 11 Immediate Outcomes outlined in the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) methodology for assessing technical compliance with the FATF Recommendations and the effectiveness of AML/CFT/CPF systems during mutual evaluations? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: International cooperation provides actionable information to use against criminals.
options_en.B: Those convicted of money laundering offenses are denied access to basic banking services.
options_en.C: Money laundering offenses are investigated and criminally prosecuted.
options_en.D: Financial intelligence information is collected by relevant authorities and shared with FATF for further investigation.
options_en.E: Supervisors effectively supervise financial institutions and non-bank financial institutions for risk-based AML/CFT implementation.
